text: Like Parmigiano it is a cooked, slowly ripened grana from partly skimmed raw milk, but its rules allow the preservative lysozyme and a shorter 9‑month minimum. That gives a younger, milder cheese from a much larger area.

sources.text: The table, the facts and the words on how it is made, from these.

steps.note: The milk is left to stand, so its cream rises and partly skims it.
The curd is cooked in its whey.
The curd is put into moulds 35–45 cm across, 24–40 kg, and left for at least 36 hours.
The cheese is left in brine for 14 to 30 days.
Cheese aged over 20 months is sold as a riserva, a reserve.
